name: Golden PM
subtitle: Projects for Golden A/S PMs
promotionalText: Projects, approvals, drawings, team and inbox — the project manager's view of the Golden A/S portal.
description:
Golden PM is the project-management application for the project managers of Golden Automation Systems (Golden A/S), the marine electrical, automation and navigation systems integrator based in Keratsini, Greece, with branches in Italy and the Netherlands.

An account issued by Golden A/S is required. The app is a companion to the Golden A/S portal and is not intended for the general public.

With it a project manager can:
• follow every project and sub-project with progress, issues and submittals
• approve timesheets, leave requests and parts requisitions from the team
• track drawings and documents due to the yard and the classification society
• read the inbox of portal notifications and reminders
• see the team on site, their requests and who is away
• work offline and synchronise later

Sign-in with password and authenticator code, or with Face ID / Touch ID and passkeys after the first sign-in. All data stays on the Golden A/S portal; nothing is shared with third parties.
whatsNew: First App Store release of Golden PM: projects, approvals, drawings and submittals, inbox, team, offline, passkeys.
reviewNotes:
This is the project-management application for employees of Golden Automation Systems (Golden A/S); it is distributed unlisted to our staff and requires an account issued by the company.

Please sign in with the demo account provided (a project-manager user with a demo project; no real customer data). No authenticator code is needed for this account. After sign-in: Home shows the project summary and items needing a decision; Projects lists the projects; Approvals shows drawings and submittals; Team shows the people on site. Push notifications and passkeys are optional.
